name: Neo-Kyoto 2099: Neon Syndicate
description: A vertical megacity ruled by omnipotent megacorporations, black-market cyberware surgeons, and decentralized hacker collectives living beneath holographic skies.
setting: Neo-Kyoto spans 300 levels of skyward sprawl. The upper penthouses pierce the smog clouds in perpetual sunlight, while Sector 0 below is a rain-slicked labyrinth of noodle stalls, synth-drug dens, and rogue cyber-samurai.
logic: Cyberware implants require immunosuppressant booster chips every 72 hours or neural feedback ensues.
Corporate security drones have automatic shoot-to-kill authorizations in high-class biometric zones.
Data stored on military cold-wallets can only be decrypted through physical neural jack connection.
The rain in Sector 4 is mildly corrosive industrial fallout—always wear coated synthetics.
AI constructs above Turing Class 4 are illegal under the 2088 Geneva Matrix Accord.

loreEntries.summary: The dominant biotechnology conglomerate holding patents on 80% of human organ synthesizers.
The rogue encrypted cyberspace frequency where black-hat netrunners trade corporate secrets.

characters.name: Ren 'Glitch' Takahashi
characters.bio: A former corporate data architect who went rogue after discovering AcroCorp's illegal memory wiping project.

characters.name: Mira Vance
characters.bio: Ex-special forces bodyguard with titanium-alloy skeletal reinforcements and thermal optic cyber-eyes.

characters.name: Kuroda San
characters.bio: An ancient cyber-enhanced patriarch who communicates through biometric projection fans.
characters.secret: Suffering from cyber-dementia and secretly transferring his mind into a clone.

scenarios.title: Midnight Data Heist at Apex Tower
scenarios.description: A thunderstorm knocks out secondary radar at AcroCorp's 140th floor laboratory. You have 7 minutes before the backup emergency grid comes online.
scenarios.starterAction: I slice through the maintenance vent lock with my monoblade and slip into the terminal room.
